id: Musik gamelan buatan kode: saron, bonang, kenong, gong, kendang; lebih cepat saat bos; nada pelog di zaman Kalabendu, slendro saat zaman membaik (bisa dimatikan di Pengaturan)
Cerita mengikuti jagoan yang kau pilih (Sri, Ujang, Mak Inah, atau Bayu)
Adegan perkenalan saat Sri, Ujang, dan Mak Inah bergabung
Pejabat Tinggi dan Batara Kala sedikit lebih cepat dikalahkan
en: Gamelan music made in code: saron, bonang, kenong, gong, kendang; faster during bosses; pelog tuning in Kalabendu, slendro as the age heals (can be turned off in Settings)
The story follows the hero you pick (Sri, Ujang, Mak Inah or Bayu)
Intro scenes when Sri, Ujang and Mak Inah join
High Official and Batara Kala are a little quicker to beat
